title: OSRS's First New Skill Won by 591 Votes
hook: Old School RuneScape waited 17 years for a new skill, and Sailing beat Shamanism by just 591 votes out of nearly 179,000. Which one would you have picked?
script: Did you know Old School RuneScape went seventeen years without a single new skill? The last one was Hunter, added back in 2006. Players guarded that list of twenty-three skills fiercely. In 2019 Jagex proposed a new skill called Warding and put it to a vote. More than one hundred twenty five thousand players voted, and sixty six percent said yes. But Old School polls needed seventy-five percent to pass, so Warding failed. Then in 2023 Jagex tried again with three pitches: Sailing, Shamanism, and Taming. Almost one hundred seventy nine thousand players voted. Sailing got one hundred five thousand seven hundred ninety nine votes. Shamanism got one hundred five thousand two hundred and eight. That is a gap of just five hundred ninety one votes. Shamanism did not lose for good, since Jagex kept it in the backlog as a possible future skill. Sailing won the day, and Jagex spent the next two and a half years building it alongside the community. It finally launched on November nineteenth, 2025, as the first new skill in Old School RuneScape's history. Players can now build boats, sail to new islands, and fight at sea. This week marks one year since that launch. Would you have voted Sailing, Shamanism, or Taming? Follow for more gaming history.
